notes.manas-2010:p0920:b001:l035: Printed Чын жүзүнө чөп чыккан is syntactically awkward. Read Чын adverbially, truly, and attach surface to earth in the next row; raw not emended to жер жүзүнө.
notes.manas-2010:p0921:b001:l005: Printed Манасың addressed as Manas within the second-person destiny formula; possessive morphology not silently corrected in raw.
notes.manas-2010:p0921:b001:l009: The third-person longing and once-before-your-eyes statement are retained. Their exact relation to the promised lifelong companionship remains qualified; no invented reunion episode.
notes.manas-2010:p0921:b001:l025: бушман read as distress in contrast/rhyme with душман, enemy, two rows later.
notes.manas-2010:p0921:b001:l030: кайып here the unseen supernatural realm as carer; preceding кайып болот means vanish. Different contextual senses preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0922:b001:l005: кең көйнөк literally broad-shirted; generous-hearted is the character metaphor, not a garment size instruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0922:b001:l012: Attaining its desire is retained despite the preceding failure to rear it; the next lines explain vanishing, but no negative is inserted here.
notes.manas-2010:p0922:b003:l002: Төшөккө жакын, эрге тынч retained as fond of bed, easy upon her husband; this favorable/ambivalent line is not rewritten to fit the following insults.
notes.manas-2010:p0922:b003:l004: шылкылдак = loose/slack/flopping, Yudakhin and1969 explanatory dictionary. Character description slack and flighty is contextual; not giggling. https://el-sozduk.kg/шылкылдак/
notes.manas-2010:p0922:b003:l009: үтүрөң тентек = hot-tempered troublemaker, exact Yudakhin phrase. https://el-sozduk.kg/үтүрөң/
notes.manas-2010:p0922:b003:l014: буласта- = appear striking/beautiful,1969 explanatory dictionary; flattering physical description retained amid insults, not replaced by disruptive behavior. https://el-sozduk.kg/буласта/
notes.manas-2010:p0923:b001:l024: Bakay's prediction of childlessness retained as character speech, not narration establishing fact.
notes.manas-2010:p0924:b001:l031: зар read as plea/lament directed to Allah; exact syntax qualified, not changed to valuable gold because previous line uses gold.
notes.manas-2010:p0925:b001:l003: Numberless concerns retained literally despite surrounding praise; no speculative change into freedom from worry.
notes.manas-2010:p0925:b001:l012: Garden-making by planting and house-making by building in the next line retained as metaphors for strengthening Manas; not replaced by an abstract summary of prosperity.
notes.manas-2010:p0925:b001:l014: сандыргалуу = illustrious/famous in khan context, exact Yudakhin сандыргалуу кан. https://el-sozduk.kg/сандыргалуу/
notes.manas-2010:p0925:b001:l017: түрс аяк = firm-stepping with a hard, uncomfortable gait, exact Yudakhin horse phrase. https://el-sozduk.kg/түрс/
notes.manas-2010:p0926:b001:l001: Printed question mark retained. Merely flatters qualifies the rhetorical reading of жагынып; positive future she will please you is also grammatically possible across the previous page.
notes.manas-2010:p0926:b001:l021: Printed ич этинен ок өтпөс followed by кие келет implies close-to-body protective clothing. Garment is supplied from wear; precise armor type not invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0926:b001:l025: Чоң Аяр retained as proper character designation Chong Ayar. Source switches elsewhere to Akayar/Ay ar; no silent replacement here.
notes.manas-2010:p0926:b001:l030: Төөнү жаза муштаган literally a punch that misses the camel: Yudakhin жаз-III gives miss and жаза чап-/жаза тий-. This conflicts with an expected strength boast; retained as a qualified literal reading. The same formula is attested of Akayar in the primary Karalaev2 source https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Manas-eposu-2-tom_t7Xe9ZO.pdf and of clumsy figures in the Orozbakov8–9 witness. No emendation to a successful punch. Dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/жаз/
notes.manas-2010:p0926:b001:l038: Conditional sequence unless we comply/entrust the pup is not completed by an explicit matching negative consequence; preserved across the next page without inventing one.
notes.manas-2010:p0927:b001:l032: Printed Өлбөгөн жерден калышсак rendered literally linger where we should not die. Awkward conditional remains materially uncertain; not changed to a more convenient battle outcome.
notes.manas-2010:p0927:b001:l042: сан is an epic multitude unit here: vast herds, no invented exact census.
notes.manas-2010:p0928:b001:l013: White cotton/fiber token tied to the mare and later camels; literal horse-head size and blessing symbolism retained, not replaced by a monetary value.
notes.manas-2010:p0928:b001:l016: сан/түмөн epic multitude language rendered vast herds in multitudes, no precise census invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0928:b001:l022: арII → нарI, primarily one-humped camel in Yudakhin (rarely two-humped). Breed is not established as hybrid. All90/80 numbers remain as printed. https://el-sozduk.kg/ар/ ; https://el-sozduk.kg/нар/
notes.manas-2010:p0928:b001:l032: Amangen retained as printed place-name; no silent modernization to Namangan.
notes.manas-2010:p0929:b001:l003: Zhelkayyp retained as named swift horse comparison; Manas encyclopedia headword records a racehorse of Mambet. Identity across variants remains unverified. https://el-sozduk.kg/желкайып/
notes.manas-2010:p0929:b001:l013: Zhorgo read as ridge/place-name from genitive construction and travel context, not an added gait.
notes.manas-2010:p0929:b001:l019: Forty separate ways follows forty men; English each of the forty expresses the distributive without homogenizing their character.
notes.manas-2010:p0929:b001:l032: Trouser-leg comparison retained as literal boast of disregard, no claim about actual fire resistance added.
notes.manas-2010:p0930:b001:l012: чура- = run,1969 explanatory and Yudakhin; corrected draft shout to ran up. https://el-sozduk.kg/чура/
notes.manas-2010:p0930:b001:l034: кысыр тай contradictory age/reproductive wording retained as unbred yearlings, not silently adult mares.
notes.manas-2010:p0930:b001:l041: Eighty camels here, ninety at928:22/931:10; both retained.933:41–42 explicitly selects80from90.
notes.manas-2010:p0931:b001:l002: Temirkan/Temir and Karakan both designate the bride’s father in this passage; source naming variation preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0931:b001:l023: Roe-deer milk retained literally as extraordinary hospitality; no substitution of mare milk.
notes.manas-2010:p0932:b001:l002: күрдөңдү жазар: ease your burdens is provisional from the relief-of-sorrow context and күрдө/күрдөө family of intensity/difficulty. No exact headword күрдөң found. https://el-sozduk.kg/күрдөө/ ; https://el-sozduk.kg/күрдө/ . Material lexical uncertainty remains; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0932:b001:l006: мураапы read as sustaining kinswoman, Yudakhin мурапы2 relative-supporter; distinct contextual sense from inheritance919:2. https://el-sozduk.kg/мурапы/
notes.manas-2010:p0932:b001:l035: Printed folding/drawing in wings to fly retained; not corrected to spreading wings.
notes.manas-2010:p0933:b001:l005: түн жалаңкыч retained as night-devouring demon image, not a zoological claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0933:b001:l006: көйкашка = distinguished by excellent qualities, Yudakhin көйI1, exact heroic formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/көй/
notes.manas-2010:p0933:b001:l029: түмөн rendered vast host as epic multitude, no exact military census invented.

notes.manas-2010:p0934:b001:l012: Tin bridles retained literally as printed; not silently silver ornaments.
notes.manas-2010:p0934:b001:l030: Narrator transition is metanarrative verse, not editorial prose, and remains in English verse count.
notes.manas-2010:p0935:b001:l026: телик куш little falcon trained into hunting bird, exact Yudakhin epic formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/телик/
notes.manas-2010:p0935:b001:l042: канчык bitch retained; Jakyp refuses even a female dog, no euphemism.

notes.manas-2010:p0936:b001:l018: башы жок interpreted as willful/uncontrolled rather than physical decapitation, Yudakhin башсыз3. https://el-sozduk.kg/башсыз/
notes.manas-2010:p0937:b001:l005: опсолоң reckless, Yudakhin1, not a proper name. https://el-sozduk.kg/опсолоң/
notes.manas-2010:p0937:b001:l015: бакыр pauper as taunt toward wealthy Jakyp, not copper by homonym. https://el-sozduk.kg/бакыр/

notes.manas-2010:p0937:b001:l019: Birches/mighty mountain line retained as printed intrusive parallel; no speculative replacement by livestock geography.
notes.manas-2010:p0937:b001:l020: каркытта- cherish/tend, Yudakhin2 and1969 explanatory2. Full headword is distinct from каркыт- encourage. https://el-sozduk.kg/каркытта/

notes.manas-2010:p0937:b001:l037: как баш literally dried/barren head, curse on an old man; retained as barren old head, not a factual declaration of childlessness.
notes.manas-2010:p0938:b001:l011: Urum retained as traditional place-name; no fixed modern country asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0938:b001:l028: чура- run and койчо like a sheep both preserved; no invented shouting. https://el-sozduk.kg/чура/
notes.manas-2010:p0938:b001:l036: көктөн inferred blue cloth from sewn tent, not literally a tent made of sky.
notes.manas-2010:p0938:b001:l039: ордо ат- play the knucklebone game representing battle for the khan’s court, Yudakhin ордо3. English gloss replaces unexplained game-name transliteration. https://el-sozduk.kg/ордо/
